subject: Re: Intermittent missing answers when using /v1/chat - Greendata
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@greendata.ai>
To: support@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Missing section in model reply - sample attached

Hi team,

We're seeing intermittent 'missing' answers when hitting the chat API. In about 3% of requests the assistant returns a partial reply (abrupt end) or an empty 'content' field for the assistant role. Attached is one of the request payloads and the session_id.

Snippet: 
{
  "session_id": "gd-usr-78b2",
  "prompt": "Summarize the policy document in 3 bullets.",
  "response": null
}

This happened twice during our morning load test. We did not change client code between runs. Can you confirm if this was on your side?

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations, Greendata

Attachment: greendata-sample-request.json (application/json, 2KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@greendata.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 15:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missing section in model reply - sample attached

Hi Samira — thanks for the report and the sample payload. We're going to triage this right away. A few quick asks to help narrow scope: 

- Can you share the session_id (you included gd-usr-78b2, is that the same as in the attached file?) and a request timestamp (UTC) if available?
- Do you have any upstream proxies or middleware that might truncate request/response bodies? If so, can you pull a proxy trace for the timestamp window?
- If possible, can you re-run the single failing request with header X-Redwood-Debug: 1 so we can capture request_id on our side.

We'll try to reproduce from our end once we have the exact timestamp and request_id.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

(On behalf of Redwood Support)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Missing section in model reply - sample attached

Connor — I ran a quick reproduction against the same model family and region reported by the customer. Summary below: 

- Time window: 2028-07-18T21:25:00Z — 21:40:00Z (approx)
- Model: gptx-8k-v1 (cpu inference shim, same variant listed in payload)
- Region tested: us-west-2 (closest match)
- Load: single request, repeated 50x with same prompt and varying seeds

Results: 
- All 50 attempts returned full assistant content. No empty assistant.content fields and no truncated token sequences observed.
- No server-side timeouts in our logs for request_ids corresponding to the window you sent.

Attached: repro_attempts.log — dump of requests we ran (includes timestamps and request_ids).

Next steps: If the customer can provide the exact timestamp and any proxy logs, we can correlate with our edge logs. At the moment we cannot reproduce on Redwood.

Marissa
Customer Success Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: repro_attempts.log (text, 14KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Missing section in model reply - sample attached

Looping in a short engineering analysis. I pulled edge traces for the approximate window Marissa tested and also the full day. Key notes: 

- No server-side 5xx or inference-worker OOM events correlated to the customer's session_id.
- We did observe several short-lived TCP resets from the same external IP range that match common misconfigured proxies that terminate keep-alive connections prematurely. TCP resets would present as truncated responses to the client even though the model completed generation server-side.
- Example trace (redacted): 
  --- EDGE TRACE START ---
  request_id: r-8f3a2b
  upstream: model-pool-3
  backend_end: 2028-07-18T21:27:12.123Z
  bytes_sent: 12.4KB
  tcp_events: [SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK, PSH, RST]
  --- EDGE TRACE END ---

This pattern matches the customer's description of an abrupt end or empty assistant.content when the client library receives a socket reset before the full body arrives. Client-side timeouts or proxy size/idle limits can cause this.

Recommendation: ask the customer for a proxy trace and to check any intermediate timeout settings (e.g., Nginx proxy_read_timeout, AWS ALB idle timeout). Also suggest they add the X-Redwood-Debug header to capture request_id for us in the next run.

Jonas Weber
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: proxy-trace-snippet.txt (small redacted snippet)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@greendata.ai>, Greendata Support <support@greendata.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent missing answers when using /v1/chat - Greendata

Hi Samira — quick closure note from our side after the triage above. 

What we found: 
- Our reproduction runs and edge logs do not show any server-side failures or inference truncations that would account for the reported behavior. 
- Engineering found evidence consistent with upstream connection resets (TCP RST) during the customer's timeframe. When the TCP connection is reset before the response body is fully transmitted, the client can observe an empty or truncated assistant response even though generation completed.

What we recommend you check on your side: 
1) Verify any intermediate proxies/load balancers for short idle timeouts (ALB/Nginx/Caddy). Increase proxy_read_timeout and idle timeout to 90s and re-test.
2) If you use a client-side HTTP library with a small max-buffer or early abort on partial reads, please increase buffer sizes or disable aggressive early-return behavior.
3) Re-run the single failing request with header X-Redwood-Debug: 1 and provide the request_id header value if you see a problem again — we'll correlate immediately.

If you prefer, we can book a short joint debugging session (20–30m) — we can have an SRE on the call to walk through proxy traces and capture a live request. Let me know availability.

Thanks for reporting this promptly — based on our findings we are marking this as "not reproduced on Redwood infrastructure" for now. We'll re-open the incident if you provide request_id traces that show server-side correlation.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Support Desk

Attachments: greendata-sample-request.json, repro_attempts.log, proxy-trace-snippet.txt
